Chill Vibes and Great Brews at Turtle Lake Brewery
Oct 2024 • Solo
Turtle Lake Brewery in Hanoi has become one of my favorite spots to unwind. The vibe here is laid-back and inviting—perfect for hanging out after a long day. They’ve got a solid lineup of beers, it changes often, and every one I've tried has been on point. There’s something for everyone, whether you’re a craft beer nerd or just here for a casual drink; and the customers are a great mix of locals and foreigners. The food is good too! - and there are healthy options, yay!

The staff are super friendly and try their best (some are local university trainees so they might not get it right all the time, but it's clear that they are trying hard). And I have to give a shout out to Lamont, the owner—he’s often around, chatting with customers and making everyone feel welcome. You can tell he’s put a lot of heart into the place, and it really shows. If you’re in Hanoi and need a chill spot with great beer, I totally recommend Turtle Lake.

Check out this boozy oasis!
Apr 2023 • Couples
This was our first outing in Hanoi with our ‘local’ friends. It was a fantastic start! A superb venue with great music being pumped out by various DJ’s during our visit. It has a great vibe and being able to see the brewery tanks was a plus. The outdoor seating area is big but is very comfortable. 
Great selection of craft beers available of course. Nice wine too. Food highlights include the excellent wings, wicked Cuban sandwich and spicy tofu. 
Inside features a great bar, pool tables and darts. Attentive service and a visit from the manager capped off a stellar visit. 
As a plus, the washrooms are very clean and tidy. Trust me, it can be dicey here. No judgment, just facts.

Interesting beers.
Mar 2023 • Friends
Came here for a few beers on a Sunday afternoon. The previous week we turned up only to find it was booked for a private function, something that might have been on a sign at the door (say) before we sat down. No dramas, this time was all good.

There's not really a view of the lake, but it's a pleasant enough place to sit down for a beer. Beers are quite different. We stayed with Not Your Daddys mostly, but tried a Mango IPA which was interesting but I'd probably not try it again.

Service is reasonable although seems to be overly attentive or disappeared. Not sure how it would go if there was a big crowd.

Overall not bad, good place for a group.

Nice location, but if you are a beer geek don't waste your time
Nov 2022
The last time I was here in 2019, I left because the service was so bad. I came back after 3 years in November 2022 thanks to Covid. The service was better but the place was still pretty dire. I tried to order a flight of four beers but almost all of the 16 on the board were not available. Why are they still on the board? In fact in the three years since I was last here there were just two new beers. Nice location, but as a beer destination it’s poor. There are many other places close by that are so much better than Turtle Lake I’m sad to say. The location is awesome but the business needs a serious shake up. Really, who is the head brewer at this place and what does he do 9 to 5?
